tentativas.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D cutout skeletal-animation parts atlas for the little girl's legs in a side-scrolling game. Reference image is ONLY a style/material/color reference, not an edit target. Create a NEW genuinely transparent RGBA image, 1536x1024 landscape. Exactly SIX isolated painted pieces in a perfectly spaced 3-column x 2-row grid, one component in each cell, no labels, no guides, no ground shadow. These are separate pieces for a rig, NOT complete characters or whole legs. Top row near leg: cell 1 a bare warm peach CHILD'S THIGH, straight vertical rounded capsule from hidden hip to round knee, about 2.2 times taller than wide, rounded overlapping joint caps at both ends, no clothing. Cell 2 a CHILD'S SHIN, straight vertical from rounded knee to ankle, same peach skin, with the reference's white sock and soft pink cuff around its LOWER third, open overlapping ankle end; about twice taller than wide. Cell 3 ONE reference-style brown leather girl's ankle boot, toes pointing RIGHT, heel LEFT, with rounded toe, brown sole, buckle/strap, warm detailed children's storybook shading, SHORT shaft, flat horizontal bottom, a small round ankle connection hidden inside shaft, no leg above boot. Bottom row exact matching far-side versions of those same three separate pieces, only slightly darker. Keep all six pieces very widely separated with at least 70 pixels of completely transparent padding around each. The reference's boots, peach skin, pink-and-white socks, dark brown painted contours and polished storybook rendering are the material standard. Anatomy is a child's short soft leg, no adult proportions. The pieces must overlap cleanly when independently rotated about hip/knee/ankle: smooth rounded caps, no angular cut ends. NO dress, no skirt, no torso, no hands, no face, no full character, no duplicate ghost limbs, no text. Transparent background must remain alpha zero.
